periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Started a monthly social calendar at four library branches and reopened the Bayshore Baby Cafe in January. Family Home Visiting held its first small-group series for new parents. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold the first Riverside porch socials and run a second Family Home Visiting small-group series.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Held the first Riverside porch socials in May and ran the second Family Home Visiting small-group series. Added a parent-and-baby walk in a Bayshore park after Baby Cafe families asked for it. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Community Health Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Start a weekly Bayfront lunch table, move the Baby Cafe to evening hours in July, and hold the third small-group series.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Added a weekly Bayfront lunch table and two Riverside porch socials, bringing quarterly events to 26. Moved the Baby Cafe to evening hours in July, and Family Home Visiting held its third small-group series. Library branches now post an events board. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Parks/Rec/Libraries, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Pilot a winter indoor social series at three library branches, and recruit two faith partners as hosts in Dune Avenue.
